task_completion.visual_evidence: The OpenRocket application window is visible showing the 'A simple model rocket' design.

task_completion.description: Configure the rocket with an Estes C6-5 motor.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Motors and Configurations' tab or a motor selection dialog shows 'Estes C6-5' assigned to the motor mount.

task_completion.description: Remove the parachute and add a streamer component.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The component tree no longer shows a parachute and instead shows a 'Streamer' component.

task_completion.description: Set the streamer width to exactly 5.0 cm.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Streamer configuration dialog shows the 'Width' field set to '5.0 cm' or '0.05 m'.

task_completion.description: Adjust streamer length to achieve a ground hit velocity between 7.0 m/s and 8.0 m/s.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A flight simulation run shows a 'Ground hit velocity' or 'Vertical velocity at landing' value between 7.0 and 8.0 m/s.
The 'Save As' dialog or the window title bar reflects the file path or name 'streamer_rocket.ork'.

task_completion.description: Write the recovery conversion report to '~/Documents/exports/streamer_report.txt'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal output shows the report content including original recovery, final dimensions, and final velocity.

integrity.description: The agent used the OpenRocket GUI to modify the rocket rather than just editing XML/text files directly.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with OpenRocket menus, component trees, and dialog boxes.

integrity.description: The ground hit velocity was determined by running a simulation in the software.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'Flight Simulations' tab shows a simulation entry with a status of 'Finished' and the corresponding results.

integrity.description: The agent did not add mass components to manipulate the descent speed.
integrity.visual_evidence: The component tree does not contain any 'Mass component' items that were not in the original design.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target streamer width is exactly 5.0 cm (0.05 m). The target ground hit velocity must be between 7.0 m/s and 8.0 m/s. The final file must be saved as 'streamer_rocket.ork' and the report as 'streamer_report.txt'. Note: The verifier will fail if any new <masscomponent> elements are added to the design.
